HOW TO PLAY

The temple’s treasures

Choose your bet and spin. Match 3, 4, or 5 symbols from the leftmost reel on any of 20 fixed paylines. The total bet is split equally between the lines.

Multipliers apply to the line bet (total bet ÷ 20). WILD replaces any paying symbol. All-wild matches pay as Dragon. Only the highest payout per line is awarded.
